name: decision-model-router
description: Route Claude Code sessions to Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable with pluggable decision providers and measure routing costs.

provider.title: Decision provider
provider.description: Choose SubQ hosted routing, self-hosted laya-serve, Claude, or an OpenAI-compatible API.

apiKey.title: Decider API key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. Required by SubQ and OpenAI-compatible providers.

deciderModel.title: Decider model
deciderModel.description: Override the provider's default decision model. Required for OpenAI-compatible providers.

baseUrl.title: Provider base URL
baseUrl.description: Override the provider's default API base URL.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence required to route; 0 uses the provider default.

holdoutPercent.title: Holdout percentage
holdoutPercent.description: Share of sessions left on /model for comparison.

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: JSON override of per-MTok prices keyed by model-ID prefix, e.g. {"claude-opus-5-5":{"input":4,"output":20,"cacheWrite":5,"cacheRead":0.2}}.

enableFable.title: Route to Fable
enableFable.description: Lets prompts that invent theories, hypotheses or proofs go to claude-fable-5-1. Turn on only if your subscription includes Fable.

haikuEffort.title: Haiku effort
haikuEffort.description: Effort for sessions routed to Haiku.

sonnetEffort.title: Sonnet effort
sonnetEffort.description: Effort for sessions routed to Sonnet.

opusEffort.title: Opus effort
opusEffort.description: Effort for sessions routed to Opus.

fableEffort.title: Fable effort
fableEffort.description: Effort for sessions routed to Fable.
